attchmntText: Please find attached the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Manappuram Finance Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming no deviations in the utilization of proceeds from its Preferential Issue. Crisil Ratings Limited issued the report. The total issue size is Rs. 4,384.94 crore. Rs. 2,740.59 crore has been utilized. Rs. 1,644.35 crore remains unutilized. This unutilized amount represents the balance from warrants issued at Rs. 236 per share. The current market price is Rs. 314 per share as of November 4, 2026. Funds were deployed for onward lending, subsidiary investment, and loan repayment. General corporate purposes were fully utilized by March 31, 2026.

attchmntText: Manappuram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release  on the unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half yearended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Manappuram Finance Limited disclosed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated net profit rose 222.90% year-on-year to ₹701 crore for the quarter. Consolidated revenue from operations grew 46.2% to ₹3,356 crore. Assets under management increased 60.1% to ₹73,303 crore. Gold loan assets under management grew 92.5% to ₹60,640 crore. The company reported 46.9 lakh customers. For the half-year, consolidated net profit was ₹1,286 crore. The Board declared an interim dividend of ₹1 per equity share. The branch network stood at 5,375 locations.

voiceSummary: Manappuram Finance Limited Board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. voiceSummary: Manappuram Finance Limited submitted its Q2 FY2027 investor presentation to stock exchanges on November 12, 2026. Consolidated assets under management reached 73,303 crore rupees, up 60.1 percent year on year. Consolidated profit after tax was 701 crore rupees, a 222.9 percent increase from the same period last year. Standalone profit after tax was 665 crore rupees. The company reported a return on assets of 3.89 percent and a return on equity of 16.51 percent. Gold assets under management stood at 60,640 crore rupees. The board of directors met on November 12, 2026, to review these financial results. The presentation details segmental performance and operational metrics for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
